messages.subject: GCC Mining & Critical Minerals Executive | Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Future Talent Arabia Team,

Your executive-search focus across mining, critical minerals, energy and infrastructure in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC aligns closely with my international profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where responsible resource development, institutional trust and regulatory coordination are central to execution. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
